name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It meets WCAG AAA for users who need high visibility without sacrificing space or aesthetics. The trade-off is slightly less boldness for users who prefer thicker rings, but AAA compliance ensures no one is left struggling to see focus indicators.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring at 7:1 still fails users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—dynamic content can shift under their focus, breaking orientation. A 6px ring at 4.5:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion` support solves this, but only if the ring doesn’t rely on layout shifts. Test with screen-reader users on dynamic pages to settle it.
